title: Reasoning from stated conditions
bodyMd: A temporary permit is valid for exactly 30 calendar days, counting its issue date as day one. A permit was issued on June 1. It was not cancelled or extended. June has 30 days.
accessibilityText: Read the accompanying original prose passage. All information needed for the questions is in the passage.
